title: Transplant
caption: A manual, held differently.
description: A liver transplant manual becomes a book of weathered poetry. Turn through thirty-three pages of bleeding ink, worn paper, and implicated lives.
alt: An open book with stained paper, red, blue, and green poetic text, rubbed ink, and a curved page turning across its spine.
gesture: Pull the right page leftward to turn. Pull the left page back. Use Closer to read the fine impressions.
